inspiration: Zones as plain rows (ID, region, name, water level, lava or diving flags). A clean zone-table design we can rebuild in our own schema with our own zone names.
One navmesh tile set per zone that the server streams in and out. The technique suits big maps; generate our own navmeshes from our own meshes.
Escort and patrol routes as ordered waypoints, each with its own max speed. Good authoring format for guards and escorts; write our own route data.
One folder per language with a text file per system (zones, spells, quests, keeps). A simple localisation layout we can copy in structure, with our own strings.
A retro frameset-style status page built from small bordered-frame GIF pieces. We could keep the nostalgic bordered-panel idea with a cleaner, original look.
A name filter that rejects any player name containing a blocked segment. A simple moderation rule to reuse as a concept, with our own list.
Many quests and features are separate script files that the server loads. The modular feature layout is worth a look; the content itself is not ours to copy.

briefs.label: Bordered status panel (ours)
briefs.why: a small framed panel with corner pieces makes a server status window feel like an old-school tool; the frame is the hook, not the content.
briefs.keep: beveled corner pieces; tiled edge strips; a single banner strip at the top
briefs.change: our own pixel-art corners in our palette; a different font and layout; a dark or neon frame instead of grey
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: not applicable (UI); signature behaviour: none (static panel); signature sound: none in repo
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Zone navmesh tile set (ours)
briefs.why: a zone split into streamed tiles keeps huge maps light; the player never sees it, but NPC movement is better for it.
briefs.keep: one walkable-surface file per zone; tiles loaded by distance; regenerate a tile when geometry changes
briefs.change: our own zone shapes and tile size; our own generator; a debug overlay in our own colours
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: not applicable (data); signature behaviour: NPCs path around obstacles; signature sound: none in repo
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Escort route with speed per step (ours)
briefs.why: a guard who walks a set route at varied speed reads as alive; the route data is the whole trick.
briefs.keep: ordered waypoints; per-step speed; one route per named escort
briefs.change: our own route names and layouts; a different pacing curve; our own waypoint format
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: not applicable (data); signature behaviour: speed changes per waypoint (MaxSpeed field); signature sound: none in repo
